recentItems.title: Putin, Erdoğan and Modi attend opening of World Nomad Games
recentItems.description:
The sixth World Nomad Games has kicked off in Kyrgyzstan with a dazzling opening ceremony attended by several world leaders. The six-day international celebration of traditional nomadic sports brings together athletes from over 100 countries for events including ⁠horseback archery and wrestling.

recentItems.title: Judge sends Charlie Kirk murder case to trial with Tyler Robinson facing potential death penalty
recentItems.description:
Utah District Judge Tony Graf on Tuesday sided with prosecutors who said they had “overwhelming” evidence that suspect Tyler Robinson shot Kirk once in the neck as the ally of President Donald Trump spoke to a crowd of thousands last September in Orem, Utah.

recentItems.title: One of northern Nigeria's most conservative states is also home to a bustling nightlife scene
recentItems.description:
Multicolored strobe lights sweep across a dance floor soon to throng with sweaty revelers and shrilling voices singing along to Afrobeats in a nightclub that is thriving despite being in one of northern Nigeria’s most deeply conservative states. Despite its reputation, there is a thriving nightlife alongside strict religious codes, a morality police, and security challenges fueled by attacks by jihadi groups.
